title: More ways to play and create
summary:
Five community projects joined the directory, and its links, credits, and star counts got a tidy-up.

The project directory added 云渺仙途：凡尘篇, a Chinese-language AI text cultivation sandbox, and EzPromptla, which helps build image prompts from categories such as portraits and products.

SocialScribe joined the Vibe Coding list with browser-based writing and rewriting controls. Querynator5000 joined Hack & Build with a natural-language interface for working with databases in the browser.

UltimaX Intelligence was added to Chat Projects as an Open-WebUI-based interface for using multiple AI models without registration.
